decision.observation: The car is off the tarmac on the left grass at 3 mph in gear 1, with its headlights lighting a pine and two banners ahead. The road runs up the right side of the frame past puddles and white posts. All dots are dark.
decision.hypothesis: The car drifted left while on plain throttle and is now parallel to the road on the grass. Throttle with right steering should carry it onto the tarmac and re-align with the up-right lane.
decision.memory: Plain W on this stretch lets the car drift left off the road; the road is narrow with wide grass shoulders. W+D is the reliable remount.
